messages:
mel: Opening a small PR to tighten the fallback guidance for transient 429s/timeouts. Goal: one clear "recommended pattern" and a tiny py/js snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288
anita: Nice. Can we define the "grace window" term early? folks get confused if they think fallback is automatic platform behavior. suggest: 'grace window = short period after a transient error where routing may prefer a lower-capacity model if configured.'
chris: Also add an ops playbook: how to reproduce noisy 429s (synthetic load), where to look in model-selection logs, and a quick cache-hit-rate check for KV. 3 bullets is enough.
mel: will add bullets. question for billing: do we bill tokens at the originally attempted model or final served model when fallback happens after retries? need exact phrasing.
sdk-bot: fyi: SDK teams recommend showing a try/except wrapper for now. we don't expose fallback_model param in stable SDKs; show explicit retry+reissue. Example (py):
```python
try:
    resp = client.generate(model="titan-large", input=input)
except TooManyRequestsError:
    # backoff then reissue to smaller model
    time.sleep(backoff())
    resp = client.generate(model="titan-small", input=input)
```
and JS async/await version:```js
try {
  const r = await client.generate({model: 'titan-large', input})
} catch (e) {
  await sleep(backoff())
  const r2 = await client.generate({model: 'titan-small', input})
}
```
mel: perfect. keep inline snippets minimal; link full examples at bottom of page. add a short "Limitations" note: streaming may not be preserved when switching models mid-request.
anita: also call out cache implications: prefix/KV cache warm for big model won't carry to small model, mention resulting latency/cost tradeoffs.
chris: ops checklist idea: 1) run synthetic repro (hey load example) 2) check kv cache hit % 3) grep model-selection logs for fallback tags 4) confirm billing in UI. keep it compact.
mel: adding synthetic repro command labeled "synthetic repro":
```bash
hey load -c 150 -n 400 "curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"titan-large\",\"input\":\"spam\"}'"
```
sdk-bot: small nit: show backoff with jitter in the text, not the snippet. snippets should stay copy-paste friendly.
anita: I'll double-check billing language and update PR comment. if billing team confirms tokens billed at attempted model, we should explicitly state that and recommend monitoring.
deploy-bot: PR #1288 created by mel. CI: doc-lint OK, link-check queued, preview deployed at 2026-03-22T18:12:09Z.
chris: one last ask: add a tiny FAQ entry: "Should I enable fallback?" answer: "opt-in; use when latency SLOs matter more than absolute quality; test with your prompts."
mel: adding FAQ + merging after billing green. thanks everyone :rocket:
